agronomic_evaluation.suitability_summary: Classified as Clay (Vertisol (Chromic Vertisol)) with slow / clay compaction risk.
key_findings: Alkaline soil (pH 7.9): Calcareous conditions restrict phosphorus and micronutrient (Fe, Zn) availability. Acidifying fertilizers (ammonium sulfate, elemental sulfur) recommended.
